qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Volume procurement partnerships with Tier-1 OEMs (Apple, Microsoft, Cisco) and large enterprise relationships provide distribution scale, but wafer-thin operating margins (~2.5%) and commodity bidding dynamics demonstrate a lack of genuine pricing power.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC & Pricing Power, REJECT). IT infrastructure and hardware reseller operating on razor-thin operating margins (~2-3%) without pricing power, subject to competitive public/corporate procurement tenders and long-term disintermediation by direct OEM sales and cloud hyperscaler marketplaces.
qualitative.evidence: Operating margins consistently track between 2.1% and 2.8%, reflecting commoditized pass-through technology sourcing. While capital employed is low due to customer financing terms, the underlying business is a middleman price-taker unable to increase prices above inflation without risking enterprise client defections.
